**Technico Pty Limited (ITC's Australian subsidiary)**

According to ITC's FY25 annual report, Technico Pty Limited, Australia registered a turnover of Australian Dollars (A$) 2.86 million (previous year A$ 1.69 million) and a Net Profit of A$ 1.51 million (previous year A$ 0.81 million).

**Conversion to Indian Rupees at today's exchange rate**

Using the current mid-market AUD/INR rate of ₹67.1970 per AUD (xe.com, quoted September 2026):

A$2.86 million × ₹67.20/AUD ≈ **₹19.22 crore (approximately ₹192.19 million)**

Note: Exchange rates fluctuate constantly, so this is only an approximate conversion at the time of the query. For reference, other sources quoted slightly different live rates around the same time — e.g., ₹67.19–67.29 (xe.com; aud.currencyrate.today, both accessed September 2026) and even ₹68.18 on exchangerates.org.uk (accessed September 2026) — so the converted figure could range roughly between ₹192–195 million depending on the exact source and moment.
